title: David O. McKay
callings: Presidents of the Quorum of the Twelve
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Attends U of U 1894-1897; Graduates as Valedictorian
Married Emma Ray Riggs 1901, Salt Lake Temple; seven children
Second Counselor to Heber J. Grant 1934-45
Second Counselor to George Albert Smith 1945-51
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
